messages:
sre-bot: INCIDENT: EUW1 routing heartbeats missing (detected by regional-probe). Severity: P2 -> paging on-call. Affected: route healthchecks for eu-west-1.

ada: got the page, looking now. seeing a large drop in probe responses from eu-west-1a/b, Route53 healthchecks showing TIMEOUT.

mike: confirm - Cloud provider maintenance announced earlier but timing doesn't match. Metrics show spikes in retransmits from the AZ pair.

ada: checking probe agent logs... pulling last 30m:
```
/var/log/probe-agent/euw1.log:
2026-03-15T10:05:42Z probe: sent check -> timeout
2026-03-15T10:06:12Z probe: sent check -> timeout
2026-03-15T10:06:45Z probe: kv-cache flush
2026-03-15T10:07:01Z probe: no response from probe-host-1a
```

jess: any signs of config change? iptables? route table updates?

ada: nope, no infra deploys in past 2 hours. Network control plane shows increase in BGP withdraws to that AZ's edge.

netops-bot: NOTIFY: Provider ticket created with carrier (INC-78912). Provider acked and investigating. ETA: 30-45m.

mike: we've got customer-facing fallback kicking in - smart routing sent ~12% of traffic to eu-central as expected. Latency for affected customers is +80-120ms.

jess: tagging product: @product-alerts - potential customer impact on EU regions with degraded latency. Could escalate if it persists.

ada: mitigation plan: 1) Increase fallback ratio to redirect more traffic away from EUW1, 2) Disable Route53 healthcheck sensitivity locally to avoid flip-flopping once probe resumes, 3) Prepare for manual LB weight changes if provider indicates long fix. Thoughts?

mike: +1 to heavier fallback. I'll raise fallback to 40% over the next 5m. Command:
```
# adjust smart-routing policy
redwoodctl routing update --region eu-west-1 --fallback-ratio 0.4 --mode gradual
```

ada: doing step 2 now: lowering healthcheck sensitivity to avoid churn. Patch applied: healthcheck timeout -> 10s, failure threshold -> 6.

oncall-rotation: paging note: current on-call (ada) will handle immediate mitigation. Handing off to jess for full investigation in 25m.

jess: taking handoff at :30. please leave any open tickets and provider updates in thread.

netops-bot: Provider update: observed upstream route flap, customer routes being damped. Working on BGP withdraws to affected edge, next update in 20m.

ada: temporary LB weight tweak applied to critical customer pools (payments, auth) to push them to eu-central and us-west. Commands used:
```
# example
redwoodctl lb adjust --pool payments --region eu-west-1 --weight 0.2
redwoodctl lb adjust --pool auth --region eu-west-1 --weight 0.1
```

jess: monitor for errors from clients pinned to eu-west-1. We should consider issuing advisory if persistent.

mike: monitoring dashboards: token latency spike, 502 errors briefly when fallback triggered but then recovered. I'll ramp fallback to 60% if provider ETA slips.

ada: note: we lost telemetry for some internal probes as well; retrieving core dumps and probe agent logs to send to provider.

netops-bot: Provider update: found misconfiguration in upstream edge device causing route flap. Applying fix, will announce when BGP sessions stable.

jess: status check - any active customer incidents opened?

mike: 3 customers reported elevated latency, 1 SEV3 opened. We're coordinating with CS on messages.

ada: preparing post-incident impact summary for product and CS: list of affected customers, duration, mitigation steps. Will attach timeline.

oncall-rotation: handoff complete to jess at 1914001259. Ada remains available as SME.

netops-bot: Provider confirms BGP sessions stable at 1914001320. Healthchecks beginning to return.

ada: probing now: probe responses back from eu-west-1a at ~1914001330, healthy counts rising. Reverting healthcheck sensitivity to default.

mike: reducing fallback to 5% and restoring LB weights to normal over 10m window.

jess: I'll run a quick customer impact assessment and draft a short status update for the incident page. Key points: transient routing flap in eu-west-1 causing probe silence and elevated client latency; mitigated via smart-routing fallback and LB adjustments; provider applied fix and BGP stability restored.

ada: closing page - will keep thread open for postmortem notes. Great coordination, all. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: EUW1 routing heartbeats restored. Severity downgraded to P4 at 1914001378.
